Findings.identical_request: An explicit token is echoed in ClientToken and in XML clientToken. Repeating identical input returns the same RouteTableId without a second route table.
Findings.parameter_mismatch: Changing tags, omitting previously provided tags, reordering the Tags array, or changing VpcId under the original token returns HTTP400 IdempotentParameterMismatch. VPC scope was distinguished using a second owned VPC; token identity is not per VPC.
Findings.mutation_replay: After CreateTags, DescribeRouteTables shows the new Name and ReplayMutation tag. Replaying the original create input returns the original creation tags, not current tags. A subsequent DescribeRouteTables still shows mutated tags: replay projects a retained creation snapshot and does not overwrite current resource state. Tag ordering in replay output can differ from initial output.

deleted_resource_replay.message: An error occurred (IdempotentParameterMismatch) when calling this operation: The client token and arguments used in this request were used in a prior request that was associated with a resource which is now deleted.
deleted_resource_replay.result: Identical token replay after DeleteRouteTable does not recreate the route table and does not return the old successful object. Describe of the original ID remains InvalidRouteTableID.NotFound.

token_bounds.empty: HTTP400 InvalidParameterValue, repeated empty input has the same rejection
token_bounds.documentation: Primary EC2 idempotency guide specifies unique, case-sensitive string up to 64 ASCII characters. These probes support nonempty length 1..64 ASCII admission and show whitespace/control tab is not categorically forbidden; not every ASCII code point was enumerated.

Findings.case_variant_anomaly: A new uppercase token succeeds. Changing only token case after a successful lowercase or uppercase original returns native HTTP500 InternalError, not success/mismatch. Uppercase variant of the first successful snapshot token was retried once and again returned InternalError. Retained as observed anomaly conflicting with a simple application of documented case-sensitive distinctness; do not infer token normalization or persist a modeled InternalError policy from this capture.
Findings.expiration: Unknown. A short same-session capture cannot establish token retention lifetime, expiration, or persistence across AWS service restarts. No TTL is inferred.
Findings.regional_scope: The primary EC2 idempotency guide documents regional requests as reusable in another Region and distinguishes zonal requests by AvailabilityZone. CreateRouteTable has VpcId and no AvailabilityZone parameter. No cross-region probe was needed or performed; cross-region token reuse is documentation-grounded, not independently observed here.
Findings.limits: No account-crossing, token expiration, omitted-token direct wire behavior, numeric/non-string query token coercion, or exhaustive ASCII enumeration was probed.
Findings.capture_isolation: Initial VPC and token use the simultaneously running ACL probe prefix because task agents shared an Eval kernel. The route-table agent owned and cleaned the distinct VPC IDs recorded here, preserved the exact initial inputs, isolated its namespace, and used a new route-specific prefix thereafter. There was no shared VPC/resource mutation.

Cleanup.confirmation: Every owned VPC, every created route table, and each implicit main route table was individually described after deletion and returned its service-specific NotFound. Final scoped inventories were empty.
Cleanup.unexpected_create_outcomes: Inventories of both owned VPCs captured and cleaned every non-main route table, including any that might have arisen from HTTP500 create outcomes; no untracked custom route tables existed.
Cleanup.preexisting_resources: The observed DhcpOptionsId is preexisting shared metadata and was neither modified nor deleted. No default/preexisting VPC or resources outside owned VPCs were changed.
Cleanup.cost_scope: Only VPC, route table and tag APIs; no compute, public address allocation, gateways, endpoints or billed networking.
Cleanup.probe_scripts: No probe script files were created; in-memory throwaway capture only.
Cleanup.local_validation: No formatter, build, linter or local test command was run.
